kpis.label: Gas fees burned, last full month

charts.title: Daily active accounts, 30-day mean
charts.sentence: Active accounts peaked in 2024 and are down roughly 90% from that peak; vertical lines are statistically detected regime breaks.
charts.query: charts[].active_accounts; 30-day trailing mean; breaks: PELT on standardized log series (near_thesis/econ.py)

charts.title: Daily transactions, 30-day mean
charts.sentence: Transaction counts followed the same arc: a 2024 surge driven by mini-app traffic, then a decline to 2023 levels.

charts.title: USD moved per transaction, 30-day mean
charts.sentence: The average transaction carries far more value than in 2024: count fell faster than volume.

charts.title: NEAR Intents swap volume per month
charts.sentence: Cross-chain settlement through NEAR Intents grew from a few million dollars a month in late 2024 to billions a month in 2026.
charts.source: DefiLlama, GET https://api.llama.fi/summary/dexs/near-intents (data/raw/llama_intents_volume.json); DefiLlama sources Dune table dune.near.dataset_near_intents_metrics
charts.query: sum of totalDataChart by calendar month

charts.title: Fees on NEAR per month: protocol gas fees vs application fees
charts.sentence: Application-level fees (mostly Intents) are now an order of magnitude larger than the gas fees burned by the protocol.
charts.source: NearBlocks API, GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts (data/raw/nearblocks_charts.json); DefiLlama GET https://api.llama.fi/overview/fees/near (data/raw/llama_fees_near.json)
charts.query: monthly sums of charts[].txn_fee_usd and DefiLlama totalDataChart
charts.note: application fees shown from 2024-11-04: DefiLlama's fee coverage of NEAR apps is sparse before NEAR Intents

charts.title: Indexed to 100 at 2025-01: activity vs value vs price
charts.sentence: Since January 2025, raw activity fell while Intents volume rose by orders of magnitude; the token price did neither.
charts.source: NearBlocks API, GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts (data/raw/nearblocks_charts.json); DefiLlama, GET https://api.llama.fi/summary/dexs/near-intents (data/raw/llama_intents_volume.json); DefiLlama sources Dune table dune.near.dataset_near_intents_metrics
charts.query: monthly series divided by their 2025-01 value x 100

charts.title: TVL and stablecoin supply on NEAR
charts.sentence: Value that settles through NEAR does not stay on NEAR: TVL and stablecoin supply are flat to down while Intents volume exploded.

charts.title: Active accounts vs Quality-Adjusted Active Accounts (QAA)
charts.sentence: QAA keeps only account-months whose behavior clusters as human-like or Intents participation; the rest is automation and mini-app farming. Sampled mode, 4 months covered so far (partial block sample; see docs/SAMPLING.md).
charts.source: FastNear neardata sampled blocks (data/blocks/tx_sampled.csv, near_thesis/blocks.py); clustering in near_thesis/qaa.py
charts.query: per (month, signer) features inside sampled windows; QAA = human-like share x NearBlocks active accounts; hdbscan

charts.title: Account-months by behavioral cluster
charts.sentence: Account-months in each behavioral cluster; mini-app farming dominates the 2024 mini-app era. Sampled windows only.

charts.title: Solver concentration in NEAR Intents (HHI and top-1 share)
charts.sentence: Not estimable yet: no sampled day has enough batches to classify solvers. Partial block sample (743 of 4,900 blocks); months without sampled days are absent.
charts.source: FastNear neardata sampled blocks, intents.near execution-outcome logs (data/blocks/intents_events_sampled.csv); parsed by near_thesis/intents.py
charts.query: daily HHI of solver outflow USD, monthly mean

charts.title: Unique Intents users per day (sampled days)
charts.sentence: Distinct non-solver accounts that executed a swap on a sampled day. Partial block sample (743 of 4,900 blocks); months without sampled days are absent.
charts.source: FastNear neardata sampled blocks, intents.near execution-outcome logs (data/blocks/intents_events_sampled.csv); parsed by near_thesis/intents.py
charts.query: count of accounts not classified as solvers, per sampled day (expanded by blocks-in-day / blocks-sampled in sampled mode; an upper bound)

charts.title: Intents monthly volume: on-chain estimate vs DefiLlama
charts.sentence: Our independent estimate from raw events (priced legs only, with a day-bootstrap 95% interval) against the DefiLlama/Dune series. Partial block sample (743 of 4,900 blocks); months without sampled days are absent.
charts.source: FastNear neardata sampled blocks, intents.near execution-outcome logs (data/blocks/intents_events_sampled.csv); parsed by near_thesis/intents.py; DefiLlama

charts.title: Correlation of log price with log usage, by calendar year
charts.sentence: Within-year correlation of price with active accounts flipped sign in 2026; correlation with Intents volume was negative in 2025.
charts.query: Pearson(log price, log metric) per year (near_thesis/econ.py yearly_corr)

charts.title: Rolling 90-day correlation of log price with log usage
charts.sentence: The price-usage link is unstable; long stretches are near zero or negative, which is what decoupling looks like.

charts.title: Granger causality p-values (weekly, lag by AIC)
charts.sentence: Low p-values mean the past of one series helps predict the other. Transactions and gas fees show two-way links; Intents volume shows none at this sample size.
charts.query: VAR on weekly d-log series, statsmodels test_causality (near_thesis/econ.py)

charts.title: Does a 4-week change in usage predict 12-week excess returns vs BTC?
charts.sentence: Spearman information coefficient with block-bootstrap 95% intervals. A negative, significant value for Intents volume is evidence AGAINST usage leading price.

charts.title: DEX volume (30d) divided by TVL
charts.sentence: NEAR turns over its locked value more times than any peer: a settlement layer, not a vault.

charts.title: Annualized application fees divided by market cap
charts.sentence: On fee yield NEAR sits near the bottom of the peer group: high throughput, low capture.

charts.title: Weekly commits to near/nearcore (last 52 weeks)
charts.sentence: Protocol development continued at a steady pace through the activity decline.
